free_tier.stated: EUR 8.30/month for VPS Entry in Istanbul, printed against a struck EUR 16.60 with the vendor stating 'Same price on renewal': 2 vCores, 4 GB DDR4, 40 GB NVMe, a 2.5 Gbps port, unlimited traffic, a dedicated IPv4 and IPv6, KVM, root access, all ports open except 25, DDoS protection and a 7-day money-back guarantee. VPS Bronze is EUR 14.55/month for 4 vCores, 8 GB and 80 GB at 5 Gbps; Silver is EUR 27.60 for 8 vCores, 16 GB and 150 GB; Gold is EUR 41.48 for 12 vCores, 24 GB and 180 GB at 10 Gbps; Platinum is EUR 52.20 for 16 vCores, 32 GB and 200 GB. Windows Server images are offered on the same line, and the offer thread adds a 15 percent first-month code.
